name: reflens
description: Git Visualizer Client — visual merge conflicts, rebase, cherry-pick

scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:ng" "npm run start:electron:compile" "npm run start:electron:run"
scripts.start:electron:run: wait-on http://localhost:4200 dist-electron/electron/src/main.js && NODE_ENV=development nodemon --watch dist-electron/electron/src --watch dist-electron/shared --delay 1.5 --exec "electron ." --no-stdin
scripts.build: npm run build:ng && npm run build:electron
scripts.package: npm run build && electron-builder && npm run release:clean
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac && npm run release:clean
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win && npm run release:clean
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux && npm run release:clean
scripts.package:all: npm run build && electron-builder --mac --win --linux && npm run release:clean
